data.name: NuWa Solutions
data.description: NuWa Solutions was founded in 2025 and is headquartered in Dover, DE, with 1 total employee. The company develops Ocean Alkalinity Enhancement for verifiable marine CO2 removal, with rigorous MRV, safety guardrails, and community-first project design. It is an early-stage, pre-credit mCDR supplier led by founder Elliott Roberts (previously at Ephemeral Carbon and University of Delaware).
